Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up prototype 004, 005, 006 or 007 normal save through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. Route 4 is converted. Cerulean City is the next unconverted area. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Kanto signs now require the A button. Route 2 signs match their visible boards, and Viridian Forest has six visible Yellow information boards. Ground item balls enforce native solid collision until collected. Route 4 has Yellow encounters, dialogue, a reusable TM04 Whirlwind, and its optional Lass with two Paras and one Parasect at level 31, as in Yellow. She stands on a northern side path. All earlier features carry forward. Back up your normal save before switching; emulator save states belong to their exact ROM. Earlier download pages remain unchanged.
